metadata.description: Antevo plugins for Claude — connect your wealth or your firm's client book, and read the Executive Brief and crypto reference prices, through purpose-built skills.

plugins.name: antevo-wealth
plugins.description: Connect your Antevo Wealth account to Claude — portfolios, net worth, real assets, liabilities, markets, geopolitics and your daily brief — plus banker-grade skills. Read-only with confirmation on every change.

plugins.name: antevo-executive
plugins.description: The Antevo Executive Brief in Claude — today's editorial read on markets and world events, the risk radar and how it has changed, the forward calendar, Antevo's own probability layer, per-sector desk reads from shipping to art, a world map of chokepoints, cables, conflicts and disasters, and macro-economic history back to 1920. No account required.

plugins.name: antevo-trademark
plugins.description: Trademark conflict intelligence in Claude — screen a brand name across 50+ registers, read who holds a mark and how they file, and check the opposition window in any of twenty offices, including the ones that run it after registration. Screening needs no account. Your own watchlist, conflicts and deadlines connect with an Antevo sign-in — OAuth, read-only by default, and it asks before it changes anything.

plugins.name: antevo-crypto
plugins.description: Antevo crypto reference prices in Claude — one composite daily price per major crypto pair, a year of daily history, and technical signals on that same series, with skills that date every price and never turn an indicator into advice. No account required.

plugins.name: antevo-mandates
plugins.description: Your firm's client book in Claude — reviews due and overdue, meeting preparation from the record, and succession gaps across the book. Signs in with your Antevo Mandates firm account over OAuth; the connector can change records in your own book, and the skills ask before they do.
